scheme_name: Promotion of Energy Audit and Conservation of Energy (PEACE): Training Programme
other_conditions: Participants must be employees, engineers, or executives of MSMEs willing to undertake an energy audit.
MSMEs from neighboring districts may be included for cluster/sector‑focused programs.
benefits_summary: Provides a 3‑4 day training on Energy Management Systems to help MSMEs improve energy efficiency, reduce costs, and lower greenhouse‑gas emissions.
